name: Tides of Midnight
source:
A visual novel where you are a sailor lost at sea, your fate will be decided this very night with unexpected company...

[from [url=https://paesant.itch.io/tides-of-midnight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，你是一名迷失在海上的水手。决定你命运的正是今晚，而你身边将多出一位意想不到的同伴…
